headline: Ravens’ Lamar Jackson, Cam Jurgens To Miss Week 5
summary: The sprained ankle Lamar Jackson suffered in Week 4 will sideline the superstar quarterback for at least one game. The Ravens will not create any mystery about the two-time MVP’s status, ruling him out for their Week 5 matchup against the Falcons. headline: Eagles Release QB Andy Dalton

headline: Saquon Barkley, DeVonta Smith among Eagles ruled out vs. Jaguars
summary: Eagles running back Saquon Barkley, receiver DeVonta Smith, new starting center Drew Kendall, safety Marcus Epps and receiver Hollywood Brown were all ruled out for Sunday's game in London against the Jaguars.

headline: Commanders Keeping Lucas Patrick As Starting C
summary: For the second year in a row, Commanders interior offensive lineman Nick Allegretti has been demoted from a starting role in Washington. headline: Rams DT Aaron Donald practices in full, plans to play MNF
summary: Rams defensive tackle Aaron Donald practiced in full Friday and said he plans to play Monday night against the Bills after missing Week 4 with back soreness.
